authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

rows.method: Compare standard three-reader and skip-middle-reader execution on identical IQ
rows.purpose: Measure source output parity and prospective CPU inference acceleration
rows.seed_notes: Existing fixed tail-excess source G and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL seed 2026092701; no training or selection.

notes: F and DURA are used only as frozen source inference in this diagnostic; no TX labels, target IQ or target truth are read.
Standard and skip paths alternate order per batch; both recompute DURA and candidate; skip only removes the unused anchor reader forward.
Source equality does not prove complete ground output equality; no running predictor will be changed or switched by this probe.
Single timing on shared CPU and 112 records is not a full-test speed guarantee.
